query:
-- 1. Same-party House races (should only be legitimate runoffs)
SELECT state_code, district, candidate1_name, candidate1_party, candidate2_name, candidate2_party, status
FROM house_races
WHERE candidate1_party = candidate2_party AND candidate1_name IS NOT NULL AND candidate2_name IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY state_code, district;

-- 2. Senate races with NULL candidates in General/Called/Certified status
SELECT state_code, state_name, candidate1_name, candidate1_party, candidate2_name, candidate2_party, status
FROM senate_races
WHERE status IN ('General','Called','Certified') AND (candidate1_name IS NULL OR candidate2_name IS NULL);

-- 3. Governor races with NULL candidates in General/Called/Certified status  
SELECT state_code, dem_candidate, rep_candidate, status
FROM governor_races
WHERE status IN ('Voting','Called','Certified') AND (dem_candidate IS NULL OR rep_candidate IS NULL)
LIMIT 20;

-- 4. House races in General/Called with both candidates NULL
SELECT state_code, district, status, candidate1_name, candidate2_name
FROM house_races
WHERE status IN ('General','Called','Certified') AND candidate1_name IS NULL AND candidate2_name IS NULL
LIMIT 20;
